teile.name: Hook
teile.text: A billion dollars for a photo app. But Instagram began as something else entirely.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a man in a fedora, grey suit, dark tie and gold pocket watch stands on a dusk San Francisco street, wide-eyed and stunned, city lights behind him. Medium shot, warm rim light.

teile.name: Burbn
teile.text: In San Francisco, Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger built Burbn, a mobile check-in app.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: two young developers in a cramped San Francisco startup room, one typing at a desk, one pointing at a wall map covered in pins. Medium shot, warm lamp light, skyline through the window.

teile.name: Seed round
teile.text: Systrom closed a $500,000 seed round on March 5, 2010, while building Burbn.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a young founder shakes hands with two investors across a modern office table, glass walls behind them. Medium shot, bright daylight, confident mood.

teile.name: The pivot
teile.text: So what changed? Burbn was too similar to Foursquare. They refocused on photo-sharing.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the fedora-wearing presenter in grey suit sweeps a hand across a pin-covered city map on a wall, then lifts a camera toward the skyline. Close medium shot, dramatic side light.

teile.name: New name
teile.text: Photos were popular among users. They named it Instagram: instant camera plus telegram.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a vintage instant camera beside an old telegraph key on a wooden desk, a hand reaching toward both. Close-up, warm golden light, soft background.

teile.name: The sale
teile.text: In April 2012, Facebook bought Instagram for $1 billion in cash and stock.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: two executives shake hands at a long boardroom table while the fedora-wearing presenter watches from the doorway, gold pocket watch glinting. Wide shot, cool evening light.

teile.name: Call to action
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the fedora-wearing presenter in grey suit tips his hat on a San Francisco rooftop at sunset, holding a vintage camera in his other hand. Medium shot, warm backlight.

entwurf.beschreibung: Instagram began as Burbn, a mobile check-in app by Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger. After refocusing on photo-sharing, it was bought by Facebook in April 2012 for $1 billion in cash and stock.
